summary: Correct literal Reference page routing so explicit engineering identifiers outrank ordinary mentions and fragmented pages cannot multiply one generic term's score.
decision_refs: Fixed 15-question Reference preview selected the independent answer source page for 10 of 15 questions with zero provider calls
Sheet A3.40 and M5.01 were retained as labelled phrases instead of matching bare parser locators
Ordinary terms accumulated once per fragment rather than once per page, favoring dense unrelated pages
Historical correction: FR-REFERENCE-PREPARATION-001 was an undefined requirement reference; this routing-only change remains bound to FR-REFERENCE-PAGE-ROUTING-002 without inventing a replacement ID.
approval_evidence: The user requires lightweight local page selection to reduce irrelevant advanced-model input instead of rebuilding engineering semantics before the model.
known_limitations: Literal routing cannot recover a source page when neither parser locators nor parser text retain the explicit identifier.
Multiple matching document versions remain visible; this change does not infer which version controls.
Expected-source-page presence measures routing, not answer correctness or engineering completeness.
